title: Stale comment says bearer token comparison is not constant-time
description: transit/src/admin.rs: a comment (around lines 199-201 per review) says 'string comparison is not constant-time; this is intentional for v1 (ops/dev use only)'. The actual check_bearer_token function correctly uses subtle::ConstantTimeEq. The stale comment contradicts the implementation. A future maintainer will read the comment, conclude the code needs a security fix, and change the comparison back to plain equality — converting a timing-safe check into a timing oracle. Fix: update the comment to note that constant-time comparison via subtle crate is in place and intentional.
